sn1.20:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Tapodārāme || || 2.
sn1.20:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi rattiyā paccusa-samayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena Tapodā ten-upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ ||
sn1.20:1.4: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni sukkhāpayamāno || 3.
sn1.20:1.5: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Tapodam obhāsetvā yen' āyasmā Samiddhi ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā vehāsaṃ ṭhitā āyasmantaṃ Samiddhiṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.20:4.1: Atha kho sā devatā pathaviyam patiṭṭhahitvā āyasmantam Samiddhim etad avoca || ||
sn1.20:4.2: Daharo tvaṃ bhikkhu pabbajito susu kālakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato pathamena vayasā anikiḷitāvī kāmesu ||
sn1.20:4.4: mā sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhāvī ti || || 5.
sn1.20:5.1: Na khvāham āvuso sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhavāmi ||
sn1.20:5.2: Kālikañca khvāham āvuso hitvā sandiṭṭhikam anudhāvāmi ||
sn1.20:5.3: Kālikā hi āvuso kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyasā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn1.20:5.4: Sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti || || 6.
sn1.20:6.1: Kathañca bhikkhu kālikā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn1.20:6.2: Kathaṃ sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti || || 7.
sn1.20:7.1: Ahaṃ kho āvuso navo acirapabbajito adhunāgato || imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ
sn1.20:7.3: Ayaṃ so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Rājagahe viharati Tapodārāme ||
sn1.20:7.4: Taṃ Bhagavantam upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccha ||
sn1.20:7.5: Yathā te Bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsīti || || 8.
sn1.20:8.1: Na kho bhikkhu sukaro so Bhagavā amhehi upasaṅkamitum aññāhi mahesakkhahi devatāhi parivuto ||
sn1.20:8.2: Sa ce kho tvaṃ bhikkhu taṃ Bhagavantam upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ pucceyyāsi mayam pi āgaccheyyāma dhammasavanāyā ti || || 9.
sn1.20:8.3: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Samiddhi tassā devatāya paṭisutvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Samiddhi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || || 10.
sn1.20:9.1: Idhāhaṃ bhante rattiyā paccusasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena Tapodā ten-upasaṅkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ ||
sn1.20:9.2: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsiṃ gattāni sukkhāpayamāno ||
sn1.20:9.3: Atha kho bhante aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Tapodaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā vehāsaṃ ṭhitā imāya gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn1.20:11.1: Evaṃ vutte aham bhante taṃ devataṃ gāthāya paccabhāsiṃ || ||
sn1.20:13.1: Atha kho bhante sā devatā pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā mam etad avoca || ||
sn1.20:13.2: Daharo tvam bhikkhu pabbajito susu kālakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato pathamena vayasā anikīḷitāvī kāmesu ||
sn1.20:13.4: mā sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhāvī ti || || 13.
sn1.20:14.1: Evaṃ vutte-haṃ bhante taṃ devatam etad avocaṃ || ||
sn1.20:14.2: Na khvāhaṃ āvuso sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikaṃ anudhāvāmi ||
sn1.20:14.3: kālikaṃ ca khvāhaṃ āvuso hitvā sandiṭṭhikam anudhāvāmi ||
sn1.20:14.4: Kālikā hi āvuso kāmā vuttā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn1.20:14.5: Sandiṭṭhiko ayam dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattam veditabbo viññūhīti || || 14.
sn1.20:15.1: Evaṃ vutte bhante sā devatā mam etad avoca || Kathaṃ
sn1.20:15.2: ca bhikkhu kālikā kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn1.20:15.3: Kathaṃ san- diṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti || || 15.
sn1.20:16.1: Evaṃ vutte-haṃ bhante taṃ devatam etad avocaṃ || ||
sn1.20:16.2: Aham kho āvuso navo acirapabbajito adhunāgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ na khvāham sakkomi vitthārena ācikkhituṃ ||
sn1.20:16.3: ayaṃ so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Rājagahe viharati Tapodārāme ||
sn1.20:16.4: taṃ Bhagavantam upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccha ||
sn1.20:16.5: yathā te Bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsīti || || 16.
sn1.20:17.1: Evaṃ vutte bhante sā devatā maṃ etad avoca ||
sn1.20:17.2: Na kho bhikkhu sukaro so Bhagavā amhehi upasaṅkamitum aññāhi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi parivuto ||
sn1.20:17.3: Sace kho tvaṃ bhikkhu taṃ Bhagavantam upasaṅkamitvā etam atthaṃ puccheyyāsi mayam pi āgaccheyyāma dhammasavanāyāti ||
sn1.20:17.4: Sace bhante tassā devatāya saccaṃ vacanaṃ idheva sā devatā avidūre ti || || 17.
sn1.20:18.1: Evaṃ vutte sā devatā āyasmantaṃ Samiddhim etad avoca ||
sn1.20:18.2: Puccha bhikkhu puccha bhikkhu yam aham anuppattoti || || 18.
sn1.20:19.1: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.20:21.4: yena naṃ vajjā na tassa atthi || ||
sn1.20:22.1: Na khvāham bhante imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitāssa vitthārena attham ājānāmi ||
sn1.20:22.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā bhāsatu yathāham imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ jāneyyan ti || || 20.
sn1.20:24.1: Imassa pi khvāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa na vitthārena attham ājānāmi ||
sn1.20:24.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā tathā bhāsatu yathāham imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ jāneyyan ti || || 22.
sn1.20:25.5: devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā ||
